answers.answer: Refactor the existing MVP cleanly around the north-star model. Compatibility with the previous MVP API, routes, migrations, and local data is not required. Implement the source-agnostic foundation and the Skillpack-managed source. Defer GitHub/npm provider implementation, configurable safety policy, materialized distribution, and large UI redesign.
Discard the old local data model and introduce the north-star database model directly. Migrations may be restarted from a new initial schema.
Do not implement GitHub source indexing in this goal. The schema and contracts should leave room for source types such as github, but this slice only implements skillpack.
Refactor frontend semantics and routes around Skill, Skill Location, Trust, and Resolved Skill while preserving the current UI structure and layout.

Keep API resource names user-facing as skills. Use source-qualified REST paths: GET /api/v1/skills, POST /api/v1/skills, GET /api/v1/skills/:sourceType/*locator, DELETE /api/v1/skills/:sourceType/*locator, GET /api/v1/skills/:sourceType/*locator/resources?path=..., GET /api/v1/skills/:sourceType/*locator/resources/raw?path=.... Payloads include canonical skill:// locations.

Bare GET resolves current approved. GET with ?version= resolves a specific Skillpack-managed version. Responses include location, resolvedLocation, version, and trust status. MVP auto-approves newly created Skillpack-managed versions and updates current approved.
Keep server/modules/skills as the backend module. Use north-star naming inside the module. Resolve and resource reads belong in this module for now.
Verify parser/create/list/resolve/resource behavior with concrete automated checks where practical, and run pnpm check, pnpm typecheck, and pnpm build.
